findings.source_quote: Rejoice and praise the King of Kings!
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Alegre-vos” with “Alegrai-vos” to correctly express the plural imperative and match the surrounding lines.
findings.translation_quote: Alegre-vos e louvai o Rei dos Reis!

findings.source_quote: And worship Him with reverent praise;
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “com cânticos reverentes” with “com louvor reverente” to preserve the source’s reference to reverent praise without specifying songs.

findings.source_quote: Bow down in awful, holy fear-
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “temor santo e tremendo” with “temor santo e reverente” to convey the source’s sense of reverential awe.
findings.translation_quote: Prostrai‑vos em temor santo e tremendo—
